PrivacyNetTxt: Model files must match pinned SHA-256 hashes. Available app updates require a trusted signature. The configured account service is contacted only when you choose to sign in or manage your account. Enabled product notifications poll the account inbox and report submission and explicit interactions. Cloud polishing sends the finished text, recalled terms and enabled context to the provider you connect.
